name: [BIG UPDATE] Survive in AFRICA
desc:
Survive in AFRICA, a unique survival game inspired by the beautiful continent Africa. 🌍🌴

📙 Features:

- 👥 Form Your Own Clan: Unite and thrive together!
- 🏗️ Build Your Haven: Construct houses and create a home in the wilderness.
- 🗺️ Explore a Unique World: Discover the untamed and vibrant lands of Africa.
- 🔫 Engage in Battles: Challenge and compete with other players in epic confrontations!
- 💪 Do you have the strength, strategy, and courage to survive?
  
👑 Premium Benefits:

- 💰 Business Man Cooldown: Reduced to 2 seconds for Premium users (default: 5 seconds).
- 💚 Extra Health: Get +10 points of Extra Health.

📋 Update Log:

- 🌾 Agriculture Added: Plant and grow your own crops!
- ⚡ Game Optimized: Improved performance for a smoother experience.
- 🐞 Bug Fixes: Various bugs squashed for a better gameplay.
- 📚 Knowledge Section: Learn essen
